description: Health endpoint returns service status.
steps: Step 1: Start FastAPI service.
Step 2: Call GET /health.
Step 3: Verify JSON contains status=ok.

description: Graph routes event types to the correct first agent node.
steps: Step 1: Build state with event_type=file_upload.
Step 2: Call route_by_event_type.
Step 3: Verify route is pedagogical_architect.
Step 4: Repeat for student_message and new_content_detected.

description: Shared memory supports write/read/read_all/update operations.
steps: Step 1: Instantiate SharedMemoryClient.
Step 2: Write an entry to a test namespace.
Step 3: Read the same key and verify payload.
Step 4: Update the key and verify updated_at changed.
Step 5: Read all and ensure list contains the entry.

description: Pedagogical Architect node handles upload events and records authority update.
steps: Step 1: Build state with event_type=file_upload and file_path.
Step 2: Execute pedagogical_architect_node.
Step 3: Verify current_agent is pedagogical_architect.
Step 4: Verify tools_to_call includes ingest_material.
Step 5: Verify loop_count increments.

description: Socratic Companion node creates hint and updates cognition model.
steps: Step 1: Build state with student_message payload.
Step 2: Execute socratic_companion_node.
Step 3: Verify response_to_student exists.
Step 4: Verify tools_to_call includes construct_hint.
Step 5: Verify cognitive model is written to shared memory.

description: Curiosity Catalyst node monitors resources and creates a briefing payload.
steps: Step 1: Build state with new_content_detected payload.
Step 2: Execute curiosity_catalyst_node.
Step 3: Verify tools_to_call includes arxiv/github/briefing tools.
Step 4: Verify pending_validations write happened.
Step 5: Verify notifications list shape is valid.

description: Baseline tests for unit/integration/e2e core flow pass in CI-like local run.
steps: Step 1: Run pytest on architect unit test.
Step 2: Run pytest on memory integration test.
Step 3: Run pytest on teaching flow e2e smoke test.
Step 4: Verify all selected tests pass.

description: Teacher material upload endpoint persists upload metadata into teacher_uploads namespace.
steps: Step 1: Call POST /api/v1/teacher/materials/upload with required payload.
Step 2: Validate request schema.
Step 3: Generate material_id.
Step 4: Write metadata into teacher_uploads namespace.
Step 5: Return accepted response with material_id and status.
Step 6: Verify value can be read back from shared memory.

description: Teacher material status endpoint returns parse/index status by material_id.
steps: Step 1: Create one uploaded material record.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/materials/{material_id}/status.
Step 3: Verify status and timestamps are returned.
Step 4: Verify 404 for unknown material_id.

description: Teacher boundary adjustment endpoint records strictness updates.
steps: Step 1: Upload a material.
Step 2: Call PUT /api/v1/teacher/materials/{material_id}/boundary.
Step 3: Validate strictness enum.
Step 4: Write adjustment to teacher_boundary_adjustments.
Step 5: Return updated setting payload.

description: Teacher importance marking endpoint stores concept importance signals.
steps: Step 1: Upload a material and prepare concept nodes.
Step 2: Call PUT /api/v1/teacher/materials/{material_id}/importance.
Step 3: Validate concept and importance level fields.
Step 4: Write entries to teacher_importance_marks.
Step 5: Return saved marks count.

description: Teacher knowledge-graph endpoint returns authority graph fragments for a material.
steps: Step 1: Ensure teacher_authority_graph has seed data.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/materials/{material_id}/knowledge-graph.
Step 3: Verify nodes and edges arrays are returned.
Step 4: Verify empty graph fallback for unknown material.
Step 5: Validate stable response schema.

description: Teacher material delete endpoint removes material metadata and related marks.
steps: Step 1: Upload material and create boundary and importance records.
Step 2: Confirm records exist in related namespaces.
Step 3: Call DELETE /api/v1/teacher/materials/{material_id}.
Step 4: Soft-delete or hard-delete policy is applied.
Step 5: Verify material status endpoint now returns not found.
Step 6: Verify related boundary entries are removed or marked archived.
Step 7: Verify related importance marks are removed or marked archived.
Step 8: Verify audit entry is recorded for delete action.
Step 9: Verify repeated delete is idempotent.
Step 10: Verify API returns deterministic response code and payload.
Step 11: Run regression check for unaffected materials.

description: Class overview endpoint returns aggregate stats for a class.
steps: Step 1: Seed class-level interaction and escalation data.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/classes/{class_id}/overview.
Step 3: Verify totals, trends, and risk counters.
Step 4: Verify unknown class handling.

description: Class student list endpoint returns roster with learning indicators.
steps: Step 1: Seed class roster data.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/classes/{class_id}/students.
Step 3: Verify paging and student summary fields.
Step 4: Verify sorting is deterministic.

description: Student detail endpoint returns profile and current learning state.
steps: Step 1: Seed one student profile.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/students/{student_id}.
Step 3: Verify identity and metadata fields.
Step 4: Verify 404 for unknown student.

description: Student cognition endpoint maps shared cognitive model to teacher response schema.
steps: Step 1: Seed student_cognitive_models namespace.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/students/{student_id}/cognition.
Step 3: Verify misconception and mastery fields.
Step 4: Verify safe defaults for missing model.

description: Agent logs endpoint returns decision and tool traces for a student.
steps: Step 1: Seed interaction_episodes with trace-like entries.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/students/{student_id}/agent-logs.
Step 3: Verify logs are time-ordered.
Step 4: Verify sensitive fields are redacted.

description: Interaction history endpoint supports filters for date range and topic.
steps: Step 1: Seed interaction_episodes across dates and topics.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/students/{student_id}/interactions.
Step 3: Apply date filter and verify narrowed results.
Step 4: Apply topic filter and verify narrowed results.
Step 5: Verify pagination behavior.

description: Escalation list endpoint reads pending_escalations and returns teacher queue.
steps: Step 1: Seed pending_escalations records.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/escalations.
Step 3: Verify queue ordering by urgency/time.
Step 4: Verify empty queue response.

description: Escalation detail endpoint returns one escalation with interaction context.
steps: Step 1: Seed one escalation with references to interactions.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/escalations/{escalation_id}.
Step 3: Verify reason, context, and student fields.
Step 4: Verify 404 for unknown escalation_id.

description: Escalation response endpoint stores teacher decision and clears pending item.
steps: Step 1: Seed one pending escalation.
Step 2: Call POST /api/v1/teacher/escalations/{escalation_id}/respond.
Step 3: Validate response action payload.
Step 4: Write decision to teacher_escalation_responses.
Step 5: Mark pending escalation as resolved.
Step 6: Verify returned state includes resolver and timestamp.

description: Teacher send-message endpoint writes directed messages to teacher_student_messages.
steps: Step 1: Prepare message payload with teacher_id and student_id.
Step 2: Call POST /api/v1/teacher/messages/send.
Step 3: Validate content and channel.
Step 4: Persist message with created_at.
Step 5: Return message_id and delivery_state.

description: Conversation endpoint returns student conversation history including teacher inserts.
steps: Step 1: Seed teacher_student_messages for one student.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/messages/conversations/{student_id}.
Step 3: Verify chronological ordering.
Step 4: Verify sender role labeling.
Step 5: Verify pagination metadata.

description: Companion pause/resume endpoint updates companion_control namespace.
steps: Step 1: Call PUT /api/v1/teacher/companion/pause with pause=true.
Step 2: Verify companion_control state updated.
Step 3: Call again with pause=false.
Step 4: Verify resume state persisted.

description: Teacher global config GET endpoint returns defaults when no explicit config exists.
steps: Step 1: Ensure teacher_configurations is empty for teacher.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/config.
Step 3: Verify default config schema is returned.
Step 4: Verify enum fields are valid.

description: Teacher global config PUT endpoint validates and persists values.
steps: Step 1: Build valid config payload.
Step 2: Call PUT /api/v1/teacher/config.
Step 3: Validate payload schema and ranges.
Step 4: Persist into teacher_configurations.
Step 5: Verify GET reflects updated values.

description: Class-specific config GET endpoint resolves overrides over global defaults.
steps: Step 1: Seed global config and one class override.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/classes/{class_id}/config.
Step 3: Verify merged config result.
Step 4: Verify fallback when class override missing.

description: Class-specific config PUT endpoint stores override payload by class_id.
steps: Step 1: Create class config payload.
Step 2: Call PUT /api/v1/teacher/classes/{class_id}/config.
Step 3: Validate allowed override fields.
Step 4: Persist class override and timestamp.
Step 5: Confirm GET returns the override.

description: Notification preference endpoint updates delivery and threshold settings.
steps: Step 1: Build notification preference payload.
Step 2: Call PUT /api/v1/teacher/config/notifications.
Step 3: Validate delivery channels.
Step 4: Persist and verify round-trip via GET config.

description: Lesson plan generation endpoint creates plan draft from goal and materials.
steps: Step 1: Seed material references and authority graph snippets.
Step 2: Call POST /api/v1/teacher/lesson-plans/generate.
Step 3: Validate request includes objective and class context.
Step 4: Build generated section structure.
Step 5: Write plan record into teacher_lesson_plans.
Step 6: Return plan_id and preview data.

description: Lesson plan detail endpoint fetches one plan by plan_id.
steps: Step 1: Seed one lesson plan record.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/lesson-plans/{plan_id}.
Step 3: Verify sections, objectives, and metadata.
Step 4: Verify 404 for missing plan_id.

description: Lesson plan update endpoint supports teacher edits and version bump.
steps: Step 1: Seed one lesson plan with version=1.
Step 2: Call PUT /api/v1/teacher/lesson-plans/{plan_id}.
Step 3: Validate editable fields.
Step 4: Persist update with version increment.
Step 5: Verify updated_at and edited_by fields.

description: Lesson plan delete endpoint archives or removes plan safely.
steps: Step 1: Seed one lesson plan.
Step 2: Call DELETE /api/v1/teacher/lesson-plans/{plan_id}.
Step 3: Verify plan is not returned by detail endpoint.
Step 4: Verify idempotent behavior for repeated delete.

description: PPT generation endpoint creates generated_ppts job and output metadata.
steps: Step 1: Seed one lesson plan.
Step 2: Call POST /api/v1/teacher/lesson-plans/{plan_id}/ppt.
Step 3: Validate template name input.
Step 4: Create ppt job with pending status.
Step 5: Produce output metadata path placeholders.
Step 6: Write generated_ppts entry.
Step 7: Return ppt_id and polling URL.

description: PPT status endpoint supports pending/running/completed/failed states.
steps: Step 1: Seed generated_ppts job with each status variant.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/ppt/{ppt_id}/status.
Step 3: Verify status payload includes progress details.
Step 4: Verify 404 for unknown ppt_id.

description: PPT download endpoint returns a stable URL or signed token.
steps: Step 1: Seed completed generated_ppts record with file path.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/ppt/{ppt_id}/download.
Step 3: Verify response includes downloadable location.
Step 4: Verify non-completed jobs are rejected.

description: PPT preview endpoint returns image list for slideshow preview.
steps: Step 1: Seed preview image metadata for a completed job.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/ppt/{ppt_id}/preview.
Step 3: Verify image URLs and slide order.
Step 4: Verify empty preview fallback when none exists.

description: Lesson template listing endpoint returns available template metadata.
steps: Step 1: Seed template metadata registry.
Step 2: Call GET /api/v1/teacher/lesson-templates.
Step 3: Verify template ids, labels, and preview info.
Step 4: Verify deterministic ordering.

description: Skill manifest and entry for material_manager are runnable and aligned with tool names.
steps: Step 1: Validate skills/material_manager/skill.yaml exists.
Step 2: Validate tools list includes all material operations.
Step 3: Run entry.py with sample JSON args.
Step 4: Verify machine-readable response format.

description: Skill manifest and entry for monitor_dashboard are runnable and aligned with tool names.
steps: Step 1: Validate skills/monitor_dashboard/skill.yaml exists.
Step 2: Validate tools list includes monitor operations.
Step 3: Run entry.py with sample JSON args.
Step 4: Verify machine-readable response format.

description: Skill manifest and entry for intervene_console are runnable and aligned with tool names.
steps: Step 1: Validate skills/intervene_console/skill.yaml exists.
Step 2: Validate tools list includes intervene operations.
Step 3: Run entry.py with sample JSON args.
Step 4: Verify machine-readable response format.

description: Skill manifest and entry for config_manager are runnable and aligned with tool names.
steps: Step 1: Validate skills/config_manager/skill.yaml exists.
Step 2: Validate tools list includes config operations.
Step 3: Run entry.py with sample JSON args.
Step 4: Verify machine-readable response format.

description: Skill manifest and entry for lesson_plan_generator are runnable and aligned with tool names.
steps: Step 1: Validate skills/lesson_plan_generator/skill.yaml exists.
Step 2: Validate tools list includes lesson plan and ppt operations.
Step 3: Run entry.py with sample JSON args.
Step 4: Verify machine-readable response format.

description: Teacher endpoints use typed request/response schemas instead of raw dict payloads.
steps: Step 1: Add Pydantic request/response models per endpoint group.
Step 2: Apply models in route signatures.
Step 3: Verify OpenAPI docs show typed schemas.
Step 4: Run tests to ensure compatibility.

description: Teacher API responses follow one consistent envelope schema.
steps: Step 1: Define success and error envelope format.
Step 2: Refactor teacher endpoints to use envelope.
Step 3: Ensure error handler maps domain errors to envelope.
Step 4: Add tests for schema consistency.

description: Auth dependency is consistently applied on teacher endpoints.
steps: Step 1: Define auth dependency usage policy.
Step 2: Apply dependency to all teacher endpoints.
Step 3: Test unauthorized and authorized flows.
Step 4: Verify no route is accidentally public.

description: Teacher material lifecycle end-to-end verification passes with screenshots or API evidence.
steps: Step 1: Start environment with init script.
Step 2: Upload a material through teacher API.
Step 3: Poll status until processing stabilizes.
Step 4: Apply boundary adjustment.
Step 5: Mark concept importance.
Step 6: Query knowledge graph representation.
Step 7: Delete material.
Step 8: Verify post-delete behavior for each endpoint.
Step 9: Run regression checks for unaffected records.
Step 10: Record verification artifacts in tests or docs.
Step 11: Update progress log with evidence links/paths.

description: Teacher intervention flow end-to-end verification passes.
steps: Step 1: Seed pending escalation from companion flow.
Step 2: Fetch escalation list.
Step 3: Fetch one escalation detail.
Step 4: Respond as teacher.
Step 5: Send follow-up message to student.
Step 6: Pause companion.
Step 7: Resume companion.
Step 8: Query conversation history.
Step 9: Verify queue and response consistency.
Step 10: Run regression checks for core agent flow.
Step 11: Record verification artifacts in tests or docs.

description: Lesson plan and PPT flow end-to-end verification passes.
steps: Step 1: Prepare class context and materials.
Step 2: Generate lesson plan.
Step 3: Read generated plan detail.
Step 4: Edit plan and verify version update.
Step 5: Trigger PPT generation job.
Step 6: Poll PPT status until complete.
Step 7: Fetch PPT preview list.
Step 8: Fetch PPT download link.
Step 9: Delete lesson plan and confirm behavior.
Step 10: Validate generated_ppts and plan memory consistency.
Step 11: Record verification artifacts in tests or docs.

description: Developer documentation is updated with teacher API and skill usage examples.
steps: Step 1: Add endpoint table and sample payloads.
Step 2: Add skill manifest and entry invocation examples.
Step 3: Add local test and runbook commands.
Step 4: Cross-check links with existing DEVELOPER_GUIDE.
